title: C-UE01: расходы периода на заказанную единицу с обязательной рекламой
safe_utterances: Юнитэкономика за {period} на {marketplace}, по всем товарам, на одну заказанную единицу, себестоимость {cost_per_unit} {currency}, без налога
Посчитай экономику заказов за {period}; себестоимость и налог не указаны

denominator.meaning: SUM original product quantities, includes subsequently cancelled and returned units once; not distinct order count

cost_per_unit.validity: currency, per-unit basis, effective dates; no inference from APIs

inventory_return_cost_policy.missing_policy: No automatic COGS recovery on financial reversal

time_axes: logistic_return_date for return events; not order date
units: orders and postings as separate counters
answer_contract.currency_policy: One matching currency for each calculation; reject mixed currency without explicit qualified conversion.
answer_contract.completeness: Period expenses divided by original ordered units, with source coverage/as_of and COGS quantity visible. Separate optional cohort mode requires all-date joins and does not gate the period expense indicator.
required_outputs: delivered/kept/returned units only with qualified lifecycle definition
all marketplace costs by nonoverlapping article
COGS input and applied quantity policy
result and result per original ordered unit or null with reason
answer_contract.missing_versus_zero: Absent cost/tax/source means NOT_INCLUDED or UNKNOWN, never silently zero. Explicit user zero is KNOWN_ZERO.
answer_contract.profit_label: Result before excluded taxes and unreported own costs; never net profit with omissions.
answer_contract.cancellation_policy: Cancelled/returned units are subsets of originally ordered units; do not add them to denominator. Ads, outbound/return logistics and nonrefunded acquiring remain costs.
answer_contract.aggregation: Ratio of totals; no average of SKU averages. Round only final presentation, decimal half-up.
answer_contract.primary_order_cohort: Match each original ordered line to all financial and return events through observation_as_of across later dates; no cross-cohort substitution.
answer_contract.period_mode: May divide period financial result by period ordered units only with explicit label that cohorts differ; not an estimate of profit of selected orders.
answer_contract.save_gate: No usable saved/released unit economics without qualified advertising. Unknown advertising is not zero.
answer_contract.cogs_policy: User cost per product times qualified consumed/realized units; divide aggregate COGS by gross ordered units. Do not charge COGS on unshipped cancellations or automatically restore inventory on financial reversal. Show cost input and weighted COGS separately.

source_bindings.source: qualified FBO v3 / FBS v4 posting metadata
source_bindings.pagination: cursor until has_next=false; duplicate and repeated-cursor checks
source_bindings.purpose: Original cohort, quantities and current cancellations/status
Signed income/fees/refunds and exhaustive control; all categories, unknown services retained
source_bindings.pagination: by-day last_id until empty; no duplicate accrual_id
source_bindings.control: Every included ledger amount reconciles to financial total. Summary/control total is not an additional expense.

source_bindings.purpose: Quantity/type/logistic date. Cancellation is not post-purchase return; event date not cohort. No debit inferred from listed price.
source_bindings.pagination: last_id until has_next=false; verify date, quantity, identities and no repeats

source_bindings.decimals: Strict finite nonnegative Decimal with comma parsing; exact requested dates; no duplicates.
controls: CPO all-goods asynchronous report: daily CPO sum matches detailed expense sum
CPO selected-goods report: rows and numeric overExpenses checked
source_bindings.nonoverlap: Daily includes CPO: detailed CPO is a control, not an additional expense. Reconcile finance advertising charges before combining sources.
source_bindings.legacy_problem: expense JSON empty, explicit campaign IDs empty, CSV header only; same-period daily and CPO nonempty

source_bindings.purpose: Optional inputs with validity/version/currency. Missing inputs do not block partial report.

expressions.expr: SUM(original_order_line.quantity), each stable line exactly once
SUM(qualified signed revenue and refund components for chosen cohort across all relevant accrual dates)
SUM(nonoverlapping net commission, acquiring, outbound/return logistics, storage, handling, penalties, subscriptions, other known/unclassified costs)
Qualified advertising cost after explicit finance/Performance overlap reconciliation; never double-subtract the same charge
IF cost supplied THEN cost_per_unit * qualified consumed_units ELSE OMIT; do not charge COGS on unshipped cancellations or automatically reverse COGS on financial corrections
recognized_revenue + qualified other_income - marketplace_costs - ads_cost - supplied_cogs - supplied_own_costs - supplied_tax
IF q>0 THEN result/q ELSE null(NO_ORDERED_UNITS)
period recognized financial result / period ordered_units_gross; explicitly not cohort profit
all nonoverlapping marketplace costs + qualified advertising + supplied cost_per_product * qualified consumed_units + supplied own costs/tax
period_total_expenses / original_ordered_units; zero denominator -> null with reason

dependencies: expense completeness and nonoverlap; cohort joins only in cohort mode
negative_cases: order count differs from unit count
open cohort with later expenses missing
same-day realizations belong to earlier orders
ads empty response vs certified zero
ads also booked in finance / bonus funding duplication
notes: Mandatory advertising included and LIVE_PROVIDER-qualified for observed period; no runtime install or LIVE_DIALOGS acceptance. Optional cost/tax explicit. Period expense indicator is not final selected-order cohort profit. No bespoke handler.
